tagline: Markdown tables in Agent mode APIs (Beta): In the Agent mode APIs, table visualizations now return as markdown instead of table visualization attachments, which improves readability.
what_it_does: Markdown tables in Agent mode APIs (Beta): In the Agent mode APIs, table visualizations now return as markdown instead of table visualization attachments, which improves readability. Longer agent descriptions: Genie Agents now show more of an agent's description by default, so you can see the purpose of each agent at a glance. Comment on answers from Genie One: You can now add text comments to Genie Agent answers from Genie One.
